description: Universal hardware-aware and firmware-aware optimization engine for Windows and UEFI platforms.

entries.displayName: Activate High Performance Hardware Power Plan
entries.description: Configures unthrottled CPU states and prevents AC power throttling for minimum system latency.

entries.displayName: PCIe Link State Power Management (High Performance)
entries.description: Unlocks full PCIe bandwidth for discrete GPU and NVMe SSDs by preventing link power-down transitions.

entries.displayName: Evaluate PCIe Resizable BAR & Above 4G Decoding Readiness
entries.description: Enables GPU Large Memory Range access and provides motherboard-specific UEFI setup instructions.

entries.displayName: Verify Hardware CPU Virtualization (VT-x / AMD-V)
entries.description: Ensures hypervisor code integrity is tuned for maximum gaming frame rates without breaking hardware virtualization.

entries.displayName: UEFI Secure Boot Firmware Enforcement Audit
entries.warning: Audits UEFI Secure Boot policy to verify kernel image and driver integrity.

entries.displayName: TPM 2.0 Security Processor Cryptographic Audit
entries.warning: Verifies hardware TPM 2.0 PCR banks for BitLocker and Windows 11 platform attestation.

entries.displayName: PCIe Resizable BAR / Smart Access Memory Audit
entries.warning: Verifies CPU has full 64-bit access to total GPU VRAM for maximum gaming framerates.

entries.displayName: Above 4G Decoding Firmware Capability Audit
entries.warning: Verifies 64-bit PCIe device memory address space is mapped above the 4GB boundary.

entries.displayName: Hardware Virtualization (Intel VT-x / AMD SVM) Audit
entries.warning: Verifies CPU hardware virtualization extensions required for Free Fire and BlueStacks emulators.

entries.displayName: IOMMU / Intel VT-d DMA Kernel Protection Audit
entries.warning: Verifies DMA remapping hardware prevents malicious Thunderbolt and PCIe DMA attacks.

entries.displayName: DDR4 / DDR5 XMP / EXPO Memory Clocking Audit
entries.warning: Verifies RAM is running at rated manufacturer frequency and latency timings rather than JEDEC baseline.

entries.displayName: CPU C-States Autonomous Power Management Audit
entries.warning: Audits deep package C-state transitions on AC power to ensure consistent low-latency gaming.

entries.displayName: PCI Express Link Speed & Lane Negotiation Audit
entries.warning: Verifies discrete GPU is negotiating at full x16 link width (PCIe Gen4 or Gen5).

entries.displayName: Motherboard Fan Curve & Thermal Headroom Audit
entries.warning: Audits CPU and GPU junction temperatures against manufacturer thermal junction limits.

entries.displayName: UEFI Fast Boot Driver Initialization Audit
entries.warning: Audits whether UEFI Fast Boot bypasses peripheral hardware USB training.

entries.displayName: Compatibility Support Module (CSM) Legacy Audit
entries.warning: Ensures legacy 16-bit BIOS emulation is disabled for full UEFI driver security.

entries.displayName: Intel ME / AMD PSP Management Engine Audit
entries.warning: Audits security processor firmware patch status against known privilege escalation bugs.

entries.displayName: SATA / NVMe Controller Operation Mode Audit
entries.warning: Verifies storage controller is in AHCI / Direct NVMe mode rather than legacy Intel RST RAID mode.

entries.displayName: Trigger Safe Windows Reboot Directly into UEFI BIOS
entries.warning: Instructs Windows BCD and UEFI boot manager to reboot straight into motherboard setup.

entries.displayName: Audit CPU Hardware Virtualization (VT-x / AMD-V) Readiness
entries.warning: Read-only audit: verifies whether hardware virtualization is active in firmware for emulators and WSL2.

entries.displayName: Audit Kernel DMA & IOMMU Protection Readiness
entries.warning: Read-only audit: verifies direct memory access protection and IOMMU virtualization for DirectStorage.

entries.displayName: Audit Memory Overclock Profile (XMP / EXPO) Readiness
entries.warning: Read-only audit: checks memory operating speed against baseline JEDEC specifications.

entries.displayName: Audit Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0) Security Readiness
entries.warning: Read-only audit: verifies firmware TPM 2.0 platform availability for game anti-cheat and platform integrity.

entries.displayName: Audit ACPI Modern Standby (S0ix) vs Traditional S3 Sleep
entries.warning: Read-only audit: inspects firmware ACPI power state enumeration to assess connected sleep drain.

entries.displayName: Audit PCIe Link Width & Generation Bandwidth
entries.warning: Read-only audit: verifies primary GPU is negotiated at full PCIe link width without bandwidth bottlenecks.

entries.displayName: Audit UEFI Platform Key (PK) & Trust Anchor Status
entries.warning: Read-only inspection of motherboard firmware PK signature certificate.

entries.displayName: Audit UEFI Secure Boot Revocation Database (DBX) Freshness
entries.warning: Read-only audit of firmware DBX forbidden signature hash database.

entries.displayName: Audit AMD fTPM / Intel PTT Firmware Revision
entries.warning: Read-only audit of firmware-based TPM 2.0 microcode version.

entries.displayName: Audit ACPI Modern Standby (S0ix) vs Traditional S3 Sleep
entries.warning: Read-only audit of firmware sleep states to verify hardware standby capabilities.
